none: PAS CAM-0A1831: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [...]NTINI-ANVS P F [...] ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, 364-375. Mint is Arles, Reece period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]NTINI-ANVS P F [...]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend reads: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF II//CON(*?).
